posts.title: Welcome to RustBlox
posts.body:
RustBlox is a free, community-made launcher for Roblox, built by ItsNiki66.

What you get:
- Automatic Roblox updates on every launch
- Mod packs with individual on/off switches
- FPS cap and FastFlag editor
- Activity tracking with server region and play history
- Discord Rich Presence
- A news page where every post stays visible, even the ones you missed

Thanks for trying it. Report problems with Tools > Export diagnostics.

posts.title: How mod packs work
posts.body:
Open the Mods tab and press Create pack, or drag a .zip onto the window.

Inside a pack, mirror Roblox's folder layout: content, PlatformContent, ExtraContent or shaders.

Packs apply in alphabetical order, so 01_Base loads before 02_Tweaks. Switching a pack off restores the original files on your next launch.
